curve25519-donna_1.3_gcc13_x64_curve2551.notes: Tag 1.3, the 32-bit curve25519-donna.c, built with the Makefile's -O2. Thin: 6 to 7 of the file's 20 functions survive as separate functions (fsum, fproduct, freduce_degree, freduce_coefficients, fsquare_inner, curve25519_donna, and swap_conditional on x86), the rest being folded into curve25519_donna, which is 1,484 to 1,702 instructions. Below the corpus floor of eight, so the recipe sets min_functions to 6; on MinGW x64 the report's other 10 functions are the unnamed ___chkstk_ms and nine import thunks, and on Linux 4 PLT stubs. The 64-bit curve25519-donna-c64.c is not built: it collapses to one function of 5,553 instructions. No code in common with ed25519-donna or Crypto++'s donna port (measured: no shared PicHash at ten instructions or more).
